title: A far converted layer's packages are saved and drawn in its own map area
cause: persistPreparedAreaImport bound the batch case to the own area's site; the case already held the batch site, so the save was refused AREA_SOURCE_DENIED and the far layer never drew.

change.save: areas.ts persistPreparedAreaImport: a proved part whose retained source records this area as inspection.intakeOwnArea.areaId is saved without bindRetainedCaseTx; the package keeps the batch case id. Every other path binds as before.
readsChanged: package-authority.ts assertPackageDocumentAuthority quarantine scope: case site may differ from area site when the source owns the area (else a quarantined own-area package is refused on save and on every read)
area-display-proposals.ts areaProposals source check: same rule (else the own area hides the package, or refuses a quarantined one)
intake-destination.ts HOLDERS: an area a source of this case records as its own counts as the case's (else a resumed fold re-scopes the namespace to file:<sha>:case:<id> after the first cut)
readsCheckedUnchanged: areas.ts areaDisplayPackages and getPackage (by area_id and id; pass through the authority above)
area-display-window.ts proposed CTE and area-feature-read.ts (by package and feature id)
intake-targets.ts countsTx, packageOrderTx, packageFactsTx, recordingConfirmationsTx (by case; areaId read from the package body)
intake-ledger.ts unfinishedIntakePackagesTx and intake-evidence.ts target joins (by part and package id)
work-queue.ts import rows (package joined to its own area_id)
display-compiler.ts import_package pin (area site of the package's area)
batch area lists: area_id is the own area, so the package never lists under the batch area
change.notChanged: building-ledger.ts currentSourceProposal and consolidated-register.ts compare the package case site with the recorded building's site; they read recorded buildings, outside this task (NEXT)

test.database: throwaway postgis/postgis 01a6a70e41e6 on 127.0.0.1:25442, no volume, removed
test.asserts: far layer quarantined part saved in its own area; package row area own, case batch; batch case site unchanged; drawn by displayAreaProposals in the own area; getPackage reads it; absent from the batch area's packages; caseScopedDestination keeps the file namespace; a source without a recorded own area saved into that area is refused AREA_SOURCE_DENIED
test.regression: with the save, authority, display or holders fix turned off in turn, the new subtest fails

data: generated test_only rows and corners in an arbitrary EPSG:32643 frame; no survey input; source coordinates unchanged
